blocks.text: JAKARTA, Indonesia — Regional energy leaders are pushing to realize the $764-billion power grid as they call for stronger ties between nations in Southeast Asia amid rising electricity demand. Warit Rattanachuen, deputy governor of the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand, said members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) have been beefing up their local electricity generation capacity, including grid networks and fuel resources.
